messages:
maria: Heads-up — found a context/cancel leak in the Go generator streaming sample app when the client cancels mid-stream. Repro steps + logs below.

maria: Repro (local): run sampleapp, ctrl-c after first token. App hangs and goroutines accumulate.

maria: Logs:
```
panic: goroutine leak: 5 goroutines stuck
goroutine 45 [chan receive]:
  .../vendor/redwood/gen/stream.(*stream).recvLoop(0xc0001...)
```

maria: Sample snippet from the sample app (simplified):
```go
ctx := context.Background()
gen, err := client.GenerateStream(ctx, req)
// missing gen.Close() in original sample
for {
  chunk, err := gen.Recv()
  if err == io.EOF { break }
  if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }
  fmt.Print(chunk.Text)
}
```

joel: ah ok. sampleapp currently uses ctx from signal handler but isn't cancelling the generator. can you paste the stack trace lines around recvLoop?

maria: here's the stack (trimmed):
```
created by github.com/redwood/inference/gen.(*client).start
  /go/pkg/mod/github.com/redwood/inference/gen/client.go:210 +0x1f2
goroutine 45 [chan receive]:
  github.com/redwood/inference/gen/stream.(*stream).recvLoop(0xc0002a000)
  /workspace/sdk/go/gen/stream/stream.go:87 +0xb5
```

patrick: I pushed a small patch idea to my branch. Main fixes:
- ensure the generator's Recv respects ctx.Done()
- call gen.Close() when ctx is cancelled
- make auth token refresher respect ctx so it doesn't spawn orphan goroutines on retries

patrick: Example pattern we should standardize in samples:
```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 30*time.Second)
defer cancel()
gen, err := client.GenerateStream(ctx, req)
defer gen.Close()
for {
  select {
  case <-ctx.Done():
    return ctx.Err()
  default:
  }
  chunk, err := gen.Recv()
  if err != nil { return err }
  fmt.Print(chunk.Text)
}
```

joel: nice. also file note: Python SDK returns context.Canceled immediately from recv; Go should match that parity. Filed issue #1234 to track parity + auth-retry behavior.

devex-bot: CI failure on PR #456 — go test ./sdk/... failed (race) in gen_stream_test.go. See https://ci.redwood.dev/456

patrick: assigning this to myself. will add unit test that cancels ctx mid-stream and assert no goroutines leaked, plus ensure token refresher cancels. CC @maria

maria: :thumbsup: can we also add a short note in the Go quickstart about "always defer gen.Close() and ensure Recv checks ctx" — saves people from this pitfall.

joel: agreed. small docs bullet + code snippet should do it.

patrick: I'll open PR with fix + tests + quickstart update today.

maria: thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround :heart:
